ICLR 2024 · LATENT DIFFUSION / INVERSE PROBLEMS

用硬数据一致性让潜扩散模型求解逆问题

Solving Inverse Problems with Latent Diffusion Models via Hard Data Consistency

Bowen Song1* · Soo Min Kwon1* · Zecheng Zhang2 · Xinyu Hu3 · Qing Qu1 · Liyue Shen1
University of Michigan · Kumo.AI · Microsoft

潜扩散模型便宜、好微调，但编码器与解码器都是非线性的：直接在潜空间里照 DPS 那样做梯度更新，重建往往又噪又模糊，还不满足测量。ReSample 的做法是把“数据一致性”从梯度变成优化问题（硬数据一致性），再用一个可证明更小方差、无偏的随机重采样，把满足测量的样本送回含噪流形继续反向采样。

读之前，先把这条链路分清

这一段是译者注，不是原文。它只做一件事：让你在读到公式 (10)–(13) 时，知道每个量在做什么，以及“硬”和“软”到底差在哪。

  1. 前向算子与潜空间：测量是 y=A(x∗)+η\boldsymbol{y}=\mathcal{A}(\boldsymbol{x}_*)+\boldsymbol{\eta}y=A(x∗​)+η。潜扩散模型不直接在 x\boldsymbol{x}x 上做扩散，而是先用编码器 z=E(x)\boldsymbol{z}=\mathcal{E}(\boldsymbol{x})z=E(x)（z∈Rk\boldsymbol{z}\in\mathbb{R}^kz∈Rk，k≪nk\ll nk≪n）压缩，再在潜空间上做 DDIM/DDPM 采样，最后用解码器 x=D(z)\boldsymbol{x}=\mathcal{D}(\boldsymbol{z})x=D(z) 出图。
  2. 软数据一致性（DPS / Latent-DPS）：在反向采样每一步减掉测量损失的梯度，即公式 (7)、公式 (9)。优点是便宜、能处理非线性算子；缺点是数据一致性只被“拉一把”，不保证满足测量，且在潜空间里梯度要穿过高度非线性的解码器。
  3. 硬数据一致性（本文）：在某些时间步 ttt 上直接求解 min⁡z12∥y−A(D(z))∥22\min_{\boldsymbol{z}}\tfrac12\|\boldsymbol{y}-\mathcal{A}(\mathcal{D}(\boldsymbol{z}))\|_2^2minz​21​∥y−A(D(z))∥22​（公式 (10)），用 Tweedie 公式的 z^0(zt+1)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_{t+1})z^0​(zt+1​) 作初值，避免落入局部极小。
  4. 随机重采样（本文）：优化得到的 z^0(y)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{y})z^0​(y) 在 t=0t=0t=0 的尺度上，需要映回 ttt 时刻的含噪流形。直接用前向加噪（随机编码，公式 (12)）方差大；再以无条件样本 zt′\boldsymbol{z}'_tzt′​ 为条件做一次高斯后验（随机重采样，公式 (13)）方差更小（引理 1）且无偏（定理 1）。
  5. 三个子区间与跳步：把 TTT 均分三段，只在后两段做硬数据一致性，且每 10 步左右做一次；第二段用像素优化（可配共轭梯度），第三段用潜优化。
  6. 指标：LPIPS 越小越好（感知距离），PSNR、SSIM 越大越好；CT 部分的分组是腹部 / 头部 / 胸部。

摘要

潜扩散模型已被证明能生成高质量图像，同时相比在像素空间运行的扩散模型在模型训练上更高效。然而，由于编码器与解码器的非线性，把潜扩散模型纳入逆问题求解仍然是一个有挑战的问题。为解决这些问题，我们提出 ReSample——一种能够用预训练潜扩散模型求解一般逆问题的算法。我们的算法通过在反向采样过程中求解一个优化问题来引入数据一致性，我们把这一概念称为硬数据一致性。在求解该优化问题之后，我们提出一种新的重采样方案，把与测量一致的样本映回含噪数据流形，并从理论上证明其优势。最后，我们把算法应用于求解自然图像与医学图像中广泛的线性与非线性逆问题，表明我们的方法优于现有最先进方法，包括基于像素空间扩散模型的方法。我们的代码见 https://github.com/soominkwon/resample。

English original
Latent diffusion models have been demonstrated to generate high-quality images, while offering efficiency in model training compared to diffusion models operating in the pixel space. However, incorporating latent diffusion models to solve inverse problems remains a challenging problem due to the nonlinearity of the encoder and decoder. To address these issues, we propose ReSample, an algorithm that can solve general inverse problems with pre-trained latent diffusion models. Our algorithm incorporates data consistency by solving an optimization problem during the reverse sampling process, a concept that we term as hard data consistency. Upon solving this optimization problem, we propose a novel resampling scheme to map the measurement-consistent sample back onto the noisy data manifold and theoretically demonstrate its benefits. Lastly, we apply our algorithm to solve a wide range of linear and nonlinear inverse problems in both natural and medical images, demonstrating that our approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, including those based on pixel-space diffusion models. Our code is available at https://github.com/soominkwon/resample.

1 引言

English original
1 Introduction

逆问题出现在许多领域的广泛应用中，包括计算成像 [1], [2]、医学成像 [3], [4] 和遥感 [5], [6] 等等。求解这些逆问题时，目标是在给定观测测量 y∈Rm\boldsymbol{y}\in\mathbb{R}^my∈Rm 的情况下重建未知信号 x∗∈Rn\boldsymbol{x}_*\in\mathbb{R}^nx∗​∈Rn，测量具有如下形式

English original
Inverse problems arise from a wide range of applications across many domains, including computational imaging [1], [2], medical imaging [3], [4], and remote sensing [5], [6], to name a few. When solving these inverse problems, the goal is to reconstruct an unknown signal x∗∈Rn\boldsymbol{x}_* \in \mathbb{R}^nx∗​∈Rn given observed measurements y∈Rm\boldsymbol{y} \in \mathbb{R}^my∈Rm of the form
未编号公式
y=A(x∗)+η,\boldsymbol{y} = \mathcal{A}(\boldsymbol{x}_*) + \boldsymbol{\eta},y=A(x∗​)+η,

其中 A(⋅):Rn→Rm\mathcal{A}(\cdot):\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}^mA(⋅):Rn→Rm 表示某个前向测量算子（可以是线性或非线性），η∈Rm\boldsymbol{\eta}\in\mathbb{R}^mη∈Rm 是加性噪声。通常我们关心 m<nm<nm<n 的情形，这对应许多现实场景。当 m<nm<nm<n 时，问题是不适定的，需要某种正则项（或先验）才能得到有意义的解。

English original
where A(⋅):Rn→Rm\mathcal{A}(\cdot):\mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^mA(⋅):Rn→Rm denotes some forward measurement operator (can be linear or nonlinear) and η∈Rm\boldsymbol{\eta} \in \mathbb{R}^mη∈Rm is additive noise. Usually, we are interested in the case when m<nm < nm<n, which follows many real-world scenarios. When m<nm < nm<n, the problem is ill-posed and some kind of regularizer (or prior) is necessary to obtain a meaningful solution.

在文献中，使用手工设计的先验（例如稀疏性）的传统做法正慢慢地被丰富的、学习得到的先验（例如深度生成模型）所取代。近年来，由于扩散模型在图像生成上的最先进表现 [7], [8], [9]，把它们用作结构先验引起了大量兴趣。与 GAN 相比，扩散模型通常更容易训练、也更稳定，因为它们不依赖对抗训练方案，这使它们成为更易获得的生成先验 [7]。把扩散模型用作先验最常用的做法是求助于后验采样，这一点在文献中已被广泛探索 [10], [11], [12], [13], [14], [15]。然而，尽管取得了显著成功，这些技术仍存在若干局限。最主要的挑战是：多数把扩散模型用作先验的现有工作都直接在像素空间训练这些模型，这需要大量计算资源和海量训练数据。在诸如计算机断层扫描（CT）和磁共振成像（MRI）重建这样的现实应用中，图像本身是 3D 甚至 4D 的 [18]，直接在像素空间训练扩散模型往往是不可行的。

English original
In the literature, the traditional approach of using hand-crafted priors (e.g. sparsity) is slowly being replaced by rich, learned priors such as deep generative models. Recently, there has been a lot of interests in using diffusion models as structural priors due to their state-of-the-art performance in image generation [7], [8], [9]. Compared to GANs, diffusion models are generally easier and more stable to train as they do not rely on an adversarial training scheme, making them a generative prior that is more readily accessible [7]. The most common approach for using diffusion models as priors is to resort to posterior sampling, which has been extensively explored in the literature [10], [11], [12], [13], [14], [15]. However, despite their remarkable success, these techniques exhibit several limitations. The primary challenge is that the majority of existing works that employ diffusion models as priors train these models directly in the pixel space, which requires substantial computational resources and a large volume of training data. In real-world applications such as computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction, where images are inherently either 3D or even 4D [18], training diffusion models directly in the pixel space is often infeasible.

潜扩散模型（LDM）把数据嵌入，以便在更低维的空间中运行，为这一挑战提供了潜在的解决方案，并在计算效率上有相当大的提升 [19], [20]——办法是在压缩的潜空间中训练扩散模型。它们还能提供很大的灵活性，因为只要在小规模训练数据上微调，就能把这些模型迁移与泛化到不同领域 [21]。然而，使用 LDM 求解逆问题会带来显著挑战。主要困难来自解码器固有的非线性与非凸性，这使得直接套用为像素空间设计的现有求解器变得困难。为解决这个问题，Rout 等人的同期工作 [22] 最近提出了一种在潜空间中运行的后验采样算法（PSLD），用于求解带可证明保证的线性逆问题。但是，我们观察到在存在测量噪声时，PSLD 重建的图像可能带有伪影。因此，开发一种能够应对这些挑战的高效算法，仍然是一个开放的研究问题。

English original
Latent diffusion models (LDMs), which embed data in order to operate in a lower-dimensional space, present a potential solution to this challenge, along with considerable improvements in computational efficiency [19], [20] by training diffusion models in a compressed latent space. They can also provide a great amount of flexibility, as they can enable one to transfer and generalize these models to different domains by fine-tuning on small amounts of training data [21]. Nevertheless, using LDMs to solve inverse problems poses a significant challenge. The main difficulty arises from the inherent nonlinearity and nonconvexity of the decoder, making it challenging to directly apply existing solvers designed for pixel space. To address this issue, a concurrent work by Rout et al. [22] recently introduced a posterior sampling algorithm operating in the latent space (PSLD), designed to solve linear inverse problems with provable guarantees. However, we observe that PSLD may reconstruct images with artifacts in the presence of measurement noise. Therefore, developing an efficient algorithm capable of addressing these challenges remains an open research question.

在这项工作中，我们提出一种名为 ReSample 的新算法，它有效地利用 LDM 作为先验来求解逆问题。我们的算法可以看作一个两阶段过程，通过以下两步引入数据一致性：(1) 求解一个硬约束优化问题，确保得到与观测测量一致的、正确的潜变量；(2) 采用精心设计的重采样方案，把与测量一致的样本映回正确的含噪数据流形。由此我们表明，与现有算法相比，我们的算法在各种逆问题任务和不同数据集上都能取得最先进的性能。值得注意的是，由于使用潜扩散模型作为生成先验，我们的算法在降低内存复杂度的同时提升了计算效率。下面我们强调若干关键贡献。

English original
In this work, we introduce a novel algorithm named ReSample, which effectively employs LDMs as priors for solving inverse problems. Our algorithm can be viewed as a two-stage process that incorporates data consistency by (1) solving a hard-constrained optimization problem, ensuring we obtain the correct latent variable that is consistent with the observed measurements, and (2) employing a carefully designed resampling scheme to map the measurement-consistent sample back onto the correct noisy data manifold. As a result, we show that our algorithm can achieve state-of-the-art performance on various inverse problem tasks and different datasets, compared to existing algorithms. Notably, owing to using the latent diffusion models as generative priors, our algorithm achieves improved computational efficiency with a reduction in memory complexity. Below, we highlight some of our key contributions.
  • 我们提出一种新算法，使我们能够通过硬数据一致性，利用潜扩散模型求解一般（线性与非线性）逆问题。
  • 特别地，我们精心设计了一种随机重采样方案，能够可靠地把与测量一致的样本映回含噪数据流形，以继续反向采样过程。我们给出理论分析，进一步说明所提出的随机重采样技术的优越性。
  • 通过在多个任务和多个数据集（涵盖自然图像与医学图像）上的大量实验，我们提出的算法在各种线性与非线性逆问题上取得了最先进的性能。
English original
  • We propose a novel algorithm that enables us to leverage latent diffusion models for solving general inverse problems (linear and nonlinear) through hard data consistency.
  • Particularly, we carefully design a stochastic resampling scheme that can reliably map the measurement-consistent samples back onto the noisy data manifold to continue the reverse sampling process. We provide a theoretical analysis to further demonstrate the superiority of the proposed stochastic resampling technique.
  • With extensive experiments on multiple tasks and various datasets, encompassing both natural and medical images, our proposed algorithm achieves state-of-the-art performance on a variety of linear and nonlinear inverse problems.

2.1 Diffusion Models

去噪扩散概率模型。我们首先简要回顾扩散模型的基础，即去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的表述 [23]。令 x0∼pdata(x)\boldsymbol{x}_0 \sim p_{\text{data}}(\boldsymbol{x})x0​∼pdata​(x) 表示来自数据分布的样本。扩散模型通过高斯核逐步把数据扰动成噪声，这一过程可以写成如下形式的方差保持随机微分方程（VP-SDE）[24]：

English original
Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models. We first briefly review the basic fundamentals of diffusion models, namely the denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) formulation [23]. Let x0∼pdata(x)\boldsymbol{x}_0 \sim p_{\text{data}}(\boldsymbol{x})x0​∼pdata​(x) denote samples from the data distribution. Diffusion models start by progressively perturbing data to noise via Gaussian kernels, which can be written as the variance-preserving stochastic differential equation (VP-SDE) [24] of the form
公式 (1)
dx=−βt2x dt+βt dw,\mathrm{d}\boldsymbol{x} = -\frac{\beta_t}{2}\boldsymbol{x}\,\mathrm{d}t + \sqrt{\beta_t}\,\mathrm{d}\boldsymbol{w},dx=−2βt​​xdt+βt​​dw,

其中 βt∈(0,1)\beta_t\in(0,1)βt​∈(0,1) 是噪声调度，它是随 ttt 单调递增的序列，w\boldsymbol{w}w 是标准维纳过程。这一般被定义为：当 t=0t=0t=0 时得到数据分布，当 t=Tt=Tt=T 时得到高斯分布，即 xT∼N(0,I)\boldsymbol{x}_T\sim\mathcal{N}(\boldsymbol{0},\boldsymbol{I})xT​∼N(0,I)。扩散模型的目标是学习公式 (1) 所对应的反向 SDE，其形式为

English original
where βt∈(0,1)\beta_t \in (0, 1)βt​∈(0,1) is the noise schedule that is a monotonically increasing sequence of ttt and w\boldsymbol{w}w is the standard Wiener process. This is generally defined such that we obtain the data distribution when t=0t=0t=0 and obtain a Gaussian distribution when t=Tt=Tt=T, i.e. xT∼N(0,I)\boldsymbol{x}_T \sim \mathcal{N}(\boldsymbol{0}, \boldsymbol{I})xT​∼N(0,I). The objective of diffusion models is to learn the corresponding reverse SDE of Equation (1), which is of the form
公式 (2)
dx=[−βt2x−βt∇xtlog⁡p(xt)]dt+βt dwˉ,\mathrm{d}\boldsymbol{x} = \left[-\frac{\beta_t}{2}\boldsymbol{x} - \beta_t \nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}_t} \log p(\boldsymbol{x}_t)\right]\mathrm{d}t + \sqrt{\beta_t}\,\mathrm{d}\bar{\boldsymbol{w}},dx=[−2βt​​x−βt​∇xt​​logp(xt​)]dt+βt​​dwˉ,

去噪扩散隐式模型。由于 DDPM 表述已知采样过程较慢，Song 等人 [26] 提出了去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM），把扩散过程定义为一个非马尔可夫过程来弥补这一点 [9], [23], [26], [27]。这使采样过程更快，采样步为

English original
After incorporating LDMs, this can be viewed as a non-linear inverse problem due to the non-linearity of the decoder D(⋅)\mathcal{D}(\cdot)D(⋅). As this builds upon the idea behind DPS, we refer to this algorithm as Latent-DPS. While this formulation seems to work, we empirically observe that Latent-DPS often produces reconstructions that are often noisy or blurry and inconsistent with the measurements. We conjecture that since the forward operator involving the decoder is highly nonconvex, the gradient update may lead towards a local minimum. We provide more insights in Appendix (Section D).

3.1 提出方法

English original
3.1 Proposed Method

硬数据一致性。与 Latent-DPS 类似，我们的算法在 LDM 的反向采样过程中引入数据一致性。但是，我们不采用公式 (9) 那样的梯度式更新，而是提议在反向过程的某些时间步 ttt 上求解一个优化问题：

English original
Hard Data Consistency. Similar to Latent-DPS, our algorithm involves incorporating data consistency into the reverse sampling process of LDMs. However, instead of a gradient-like update as shown in Equation (9), we propose to solve an optimization problem on some time steps ttt of the reverse process:
公式 (10)
z^0(y)∈arg min⁡z 12∥y−A(D(z))∥22,\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{y}) \in \underset{\boldsymbol{z}}{\operatorname*{arg\,min}}\,\frac{1}{2}\|\boldsymbol{y} - \mathcal{A}(\mathcal{D}(\boldsymbol{z}))\|_2^2,z^0​(y)∈zargmin​21​∥y−A(D(z))∥22​,

其中我们把 z^0(y)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{y})z^0​(y) 记作与测量 y∈Rm\boldsymbol{y}\in\mathbb{R}^my∈Rm 一致的样本。这个优化问题在此前用 GAN 求解逆问题的工作中已被探索过，可以用梯度下降等迭代求解器高效求解 [29], [30], [31], [32]。然而，众所周知，从随机初始点出发求解该问题可能导致不利的局部极小值 [29]。为解决这一点，我们从初始点 z^0(zt+1)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_{t+1})z^0​(zt+1​) 出发求解公式 (10)，其中 z^0(zt+1)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_{t+1})z^0​(zt+1​) 是基于 t+1t+1t+1 时刻样本对 000 时刻真值潜向量的估计。这样初始化的直觉是：我们希望优化过程从公式 (10) 全局解的局部邻域内开始，以避免落入局部极小值。我们把这一整体概念称为硬数据一致性，因为我们通过优化严格地施加测量约束，而不是像 Latent-DPS 那样通过梯度更新采取“软”的做法。

English original
where we denote z^0(y)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{y})z^0​(y) as the sample consistent with the measurements y∈Rm\boldsymbol{y} \in \mathbb{R}^my∈Rm. This optimization problem has been previously explored in other works that use GANs for solving inverse problems, and can be efficiently solved using iterative solvers such as gradient descent [29], [30], [31], [32]. However, it is well known that solving this problem starting from a random initial point may lead to unfavorable local minima [29]. To address this, we solve Equation (10) starting from an initial point z^0(zt+1)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_{t+1})z^0​(zt+1​), where z^0(zt+1)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_{t+1})z^0​(zt+1​) is the estimate of ground-truth latent vector at time 000 based on the sample at time t+1t+1t+1. The intuition behind this initialization is that we want to start the optimization process within local proximity of the global solution of Equation (10), to prevent resulting in a local minimum. We term this overall concept as hard data consistency, as we strictly enforce the measurements via optimization, rather than a “soft” approach through gradient update like Latent-DPS.

为得到 z^0(zt+1)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_{t+1})z^0​(zt+1​)，我们使用 Tweedie 公式 [33]，它给出后验均值的一个近似，形式如下：

English original
To obtain z^0(zt+1)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_{t+1})z^0​(zt+1​), we use Tweedie's formula [33] that gives us an approximation of the posterior mean which takes the following formula:
公式 (11)
z^0(zt)=E[z0∣zt]=1αˉt(zt+(1−αˉt)∇log⁡p(zt)).\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t) = \mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{z}_0\mid\boldsymbol{z}_t] = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\bar{\alpha}_t}}\left(\boldsymbol{z}_t + (1-\bar{\alpha}_t)\nabla\log p(\boldsymbol{z}_t)\right).z^0​(zt​)=E[z0​∣zt​]=αˉt​​1​(zt​+(1−αˉt​)∇logp(zt​)).

不过我们要指出，在每一次反向采样迭代 ttt 上都执行硬数据一致性可能代价很高。为此，我们首先观察到：当接近 t=Tt=Tt=T 时，估计的 z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​) 可能显著偏离真值。在这一区间，我们发现硬数据一致性只能带来边际收益。此外，在文献中，已有工作指出了三阶段现象的存在 [34]，他们表明数据一致性主要对语义阶段与精修阶段（即 ttt 更接近 000 的后两个阶段）有益。按照这一推理，我们把 TTT 划分为三个子区间，只在后两个区间内施加优化。这种做法既带来计算效率，也带来对 z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​) 的准确估计。

English original
However, we would like to note that performing hard data consistency on every reverse sampling iteration ttt may be very costly. To address this, we first observe that as we approach t=Tt=Tt=T, the estimated z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​) can deviate significantly from the ground truth. In this regime, we find that hard data consistency provides only marginal benefits. Additionally, in the literature, existing works point out the existence of a three-stage phenomenon [34], where they demonstrate that data consistency is primarily beneficial for the semantic and refinement stages (the latter two stages when ttt is closer to 000) of the sampling process. Following this reasoning, we divide TTT into three sub-intervals and only apply the optimization in the latter two intervals. This approach provides both computational efficiency and accurate estimates of z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​).

此外，即便在这两个区间内，我们也观察到不必在每一次迭代 ttt 上求解该优化问题。由于采样过程的连续性，在一次数据一致性优化步骤之后，后续步的样本在某种程度上仍能保留相似的语义或结构信息。因此，我们通过跳步机制在采样过程中“强化”数据一致性约束。从经验上看，每 101010（左右）次迭代 ttt 执行一次就足够了。可以把硬数据一致性理解为引导采样过程走向与给定测量一致的真值信号 x∗\boldsymbol{x}^*x∗（或相应的 z∗\boldsymbol{z}^*z∗）。最后，在存在测量噪声时，把公式 (10) 最小化到零损失可能导致对噪声的过拟合。为弥补这一点，我们做提前停止：只最小化到基于噪声水平的阈值 τ\tauτ 为止。我们将在附录中讨论优化过程的细节。我们还观察到，在无条件采样之后额外加一步 Latent-DPS（有时）可以边际地提升整体性能。我们在附录中对加入 Latent-DPS 的性能做了消融研究。

English original
Furthermore, even during these two intervals, we observe that we do not need to solve the optimization problem on every iteration ttt. Because of the continuity of the sampling process, after each data-consistency optimization step, the samples in the following steps can still remain similar semantic or structural information to some extent. Thus, we “reinforce” the data consistency constraint during the sampling process via a skipped-step mechanism. Empirically, we see that it is sufficient to perform this on every 101010 (or so) iterations of ttt. One can think of hard data consistency as guiding the sampling process towards the ground truth signal x∗\boldsymbol{x}^*x∗ (or respectively z∗\boldsymbol{z}^*z∗) such that it is consistent with the given measurements. Lastly, in the presence of measurement noise, minimizing Equation (10) to zero loss can lead to overfitting the noise. To remedy this, we perform early stopping, where we only minimize up to a threshold τ\tauτ based on the noise level. We will discuss the details of the optimization process in the Appendix. We also observe that an additional Latent-DPS step after unconditional sampling can (sometimes) marginally increase the overall performance. We perform an ablation study on the performance of including Latent-DPS in the Appendix.

We defer all of the proofs to the Appendix. Proposition 1 provides us a way of computing z^t\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_tz^t​, which we refer to as stochastic encoding. However, we observe that using stochastic encoding can incur a high variance when ttt is farther away from t=0t=0t=0, where the ground truth signal exists. This large variance can often lead to noisy image reconstructions. To address this issue, we propose a posterior sampling technique that reduces the variance by additionally conditioning on zt′\boldsymbol{z}'_tzt′​, the unconditional sample at time ttt. Here, the intuition is that by using information of zt′\boldsymbol{z}'_tzt′​, we can get closer to the ground truth zt\boldsymbol{z}_tzt​, which effectively reduces the variance. In Lemma 2, under some mild assumptions, we show that this new distribution p(z^t∣zt′,z^0(y),y)p(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_t | \boldsymbol{z}'_t, \hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{y}), \boldsymbol{y})p(z^t​∣zt′​,z^0​(y),y) is a tractable Gaussian distribution.

We refer to this new mapping technique as stochastic resampling. Since we do not have access to σt2\sigma_t^2σt2​, it serves as a hyperparameter that we tune in our algorithm. The choice of σt2\sigma_t^2σt2​ plays a role of controlling the tradeoff between prior consistency and data consistency. If σt2→0\sigma_t^2 \to 0σt2​→0, then we recover unconditional sampling, and if σt2→∞\sigma_t^2 \to \inftyσt2​→∞, we recover stochastic encoding. We observe that this new technique also has several desirable properties, for which we rigorously prove in the next section.

4 实验

English original
4 Experiments

我们在自然图像与医学图像上开展实验，求解线性与非线性逆问题。我们把算法与若干直接使用像素空间的最先进方法比较：DPS [11]、流形约束梯度（MCG）[12]、去噪扩散复原模型（DDRM）[13]、扩散模型后验采样（DMPS）[16]，以及使用 ADMM 的即插即用方法（ADMM-PnP）[35]。我们还将算法与 Latent-DPS 以及用潜扩散做后验采样的方法（PSLD）[22] 比较，后者是我们最近注意到的、同样处理潜扩散模型的同期工作。评估使用多种定量指标，包括学习感知图像块相似度（LPIPS）距离、峰值信噪比（PSNR）和结构相似度指数（SSIM）。最后，我们做消融研究，比较 3.1 节所述随机编码与我们提出的随机重采样技术的性能，并展示利用 LDM 获得的内存效率。

English original
We conduct experiments to solve both linear and nonlinear inverse problems on natural and medical images. We compare our algorithm to several state-of-the-art methods that directly use the pixel space: DPS [11], Manifold Constrained Gradients (MCG) [12], Denoising Diffusion Destoration Models (DDRM) [13], Diffusion Model Posterior Sampling (DMPS) [16], and plug-and-play using ADMM (ADMM-PnP) [35]. We also compare our algorithm to Latent-DPS and Posterior Sampling with Latent Diffusion (PSLD) [22], a concurrent work we recently notice also tackling latent diffusion models. Various quantitative metrics are used for evaluation including Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) distance, peak signal-to-noise-ratio (PSNR), and structural similarity index (SSIM). Lastly, we conduct ablation study to compare the performance of stochastic encoding and our proposed stochastic resampling technique as mentioned in Section 3.1, and also demonstrate the memory efficiency gained by leveraging LDMs.

4.1 实验结果

English original
4.1 Experimental Results

自然图像实验。自然图像实验使用数据集 FFHQ [36]、CelebA-HQ [37] 与 LSUN-Bedroom [38]，图像分辨率为 256×256×3256\times256\times3256×256×3。我们采用 Rombach 等人 [19] 提供的、在 FFHQ 与 CelebA-HQ 上训练的预训练潜扩散模型 LDM-VQ4，其自编码器产生大小为 64×64×364\times64\times364×64×3 的图像；同时使用同样在 FFHQ 与 CelebA-HQ 训练集上训练的 DDPM [23]。然后我们从 FFHQ 与 CelebA-HQ 验证集各采样 100100100 张图像用于测试评估。为计算定量结果，所有图像归一化到 [0,1][0,1][0,1] 区间。所有实验都加入了标准差 σy=0.01\sigma_{\boldsymbol{y}}=0.01σy​=0.01 的高斯测量噪声。由于篇幅限制，我们把 FFHQ 上的结果与超参数细节放到附录。

English original
Experiments on Natural Images. For the experiments on natural images, we use datasets FFHQ [36], CelebA-HQ [37], and LSUN-Bedroom [38] with the image resolution of 256×256×3256\times256\times3256×256×3. We take pre-trained latent diffusion models LDM-VQ4 trained on FFHQ and CelebA-HQ provided by Rombach et al. [19] with autoencoders that yield images of size 64×64×364\times64\times364×64×3, and DDPMs [23] also trained on FFHQ and CelebA-HQ training sets. Then, we sample 100100100 images from both the FFHQ and CelebA-HQ validation sets for testing evaluation. For computing quantitative results, all images are normalized to the range [0,1][0, 1][0,1]. All experiments had Gaussian measurement noise with standard deviation σy=0.01\sigma_{\boldsymbol{y}} = 0.01σy​=0.01. Due to limited space, we put the results on FFHQ and details of the hyperparameters to the Appendix.

对于线性逆问题，我们考虑以下任务：(1) 高斯去模糊，(2) 修补（使用随机掩膜），(3) 超分辨率。对于高斯去模糊，我们使用大小为 61×6161\times6161×61、标准差为 3.03.03.0 的卷积核。对于超分辨率，我们使用双三次下采样；对于修补，使用缺失像素比例可变的随机掩膜。对于非线性逆问题，我们考虑 Chung 等人 [11] 提出的非线性去模糊。定量结果见表 1 与表 2，定性结果见图 3。从表 1 与表 2 可以看到，ReSample 在 CelebA-HQ 数据集上于全部三项指标上都显著优于所有基线。我们还观察到，如附录所示，ReSample 在 FFHQ 数据集上优于或可比于所有基线。有趣的是，我们观察到 PSLD [22] 在存在测量噪声时似乎表现吃力，其重建常常不如基于像素的方法。值得注意的是，我们的方法在处理非线性逆问题上表现出色，进一步说明了算法的灵活性。我们在图 6 中进一步展示 ReSample 处理非线性逆问题的优越性，表明我们能稳定地优于 DPS。

English original
For linear inverse problems, we consider the following tasks: (1) Gaussian deblurring, (2) inpainting (with a random mask), and (3) super resolution. For Gaussian deblurring, we use a kernel with size 61×6161 \times 6161×61 with standard deviation 3.03.03.0. For super resolution, we use bicubic downsampling and a random mask with varying levels of missing pixels for inpainting. For nonlinear inverse problems, we consider nonlinear deblurring as proposed by Chung et al. [11]. The quantitative results are displayed in Tables 1 and 2, with qualitative results in Figure 3. In Tables 1 and 2, we can see that ReSample significantly outperforms all of the baselines across all three metrics on the CelebA-HQ dataset. We also observe that ReSample performs better than or comparable to all baselines on the FFHQ dataset as shown in the Appendix. Interestingly, we observe that PSLD [22] seems to struggle in the presence of measurement noise, often resulting in reconstructions that underperform compared to pixel-based methods. Remarkably, our method excels in handling nonlinear inverse problems, further demonstrating the flexibility of our algorithm. We further demonstrate the superiority of ReSample for handling nonlinear inverse problems in Figure 6, where we show that we can consistently outperform DPS.

医学图像实验。医学图像实验中，我们在 2000 张分辨率为 256×256256\times256256×256 的 2D 计算机断层扫描（CT）图像上微调 LDM，这些图像从包含 40 位患者的 AAPM LDCT 数据集 [41] 中随机采样；并在其余 10 位患者的 300 张 2D CT 图像上测试。我们使用 Rombach 等人 [19] 提供的 FFHQ LDM-VQ4 模型作为该实验设定下的预训练潜扩散模型，随后进行 100K 次微调迭代。然后，我们使用 torch-radon 包 [42]，以平行束几何、在 180 度范围内等间隔分布的 25 个投影角来模拟 CT 测量（正弦图）。与自然图像一致，正弦图被加入了 σy=0.01\sigma_{\boldsymbol{y}}=0.01σy​=0.01 的加性高斯测量噪声。除了自然图像实验中使用的基线，我们还与以下方法比较：(1) 滤波反投影（FBP），一种标准的传统 CT 重建技术；(2) FBP-UNet，一种有监督学习方法，用 UNet 模型把 FBP 重建图像映射到真值图像。

English original
Experiments on Medical Images. For experiments on medical images, we fine-tune LDMs on 2000 2D computed tomography (CT) images with image resolution of 256×256256\times256256×256, randomly sampled from the AAPM LDCT dataset [41] of 40 patients, and test on the 300 2D CT images from the remaining 10 patients. We take the FFHQ LDM-VQ4 model provided by Rombach et al. [19] as pre-trained latent diffusion model in this experimental setting followed by 100K fine-tuning iterations. Then, we simulate CT measurements (sinograms) with a parallel-beam geometry using 25 projection angles equally distributed across 180 degrees using the torch-radon package [42]. Following the natural images, the sinograms were perturbed with additive Gaussian measurement noise with σy=0.01\sigma_{\boldsymbol{y}} = 0.01σy​=0.01. Along with the baselines used in the natural image experiments, we also compare to the following methods: (1) Filtered Backprojection (FBP), which is a standard conventional CT reconstruction technique, and (2) FBP-UNet, a supervised learning method that maps the FBP reconstructed images to ground truth images using a UNet model.

对于 FBP-UNet 与 PnP-UNet，我们在训练集的 3480 张 2D CT 图像上训练了一个模型。对于 MCG 与 DPS，我们使用 Chung 等人 [12] 提供的预训练检查点。我们在图 4 中给出标出关键解剖结构的可视化重建，定量结果见表 3。这里我们看到，我们的算法在 PSNR 与 SSIM 上优于所有基线。从视觉上看，我们还观察到我们的算法能够重建出更平滑、细节更准确也更锐利的图像。

English original
For FBP-Unet and PnP-UNet, we trained a model on 3480 2D CT from the training set. For MCG and DPS, we used the pre-trained checkpoints provided by Chung et al. [12]. We present visual reconstructions with highlighted critical anatomic structures in Figure 4 and quantitative results in Table 3. Here, we observe that our algorithm outperforms all of the baselines in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Visually, we also observe that our algorithm is able to reconstruct smoother images that have more accurate and sharper details.

4.2 消融研究

English original
4.2 Ablation Studies

重采样技术的有效性。这里我们通过在随机重采样上的消融实验来验证理论结果。具体来说，我们在 LSUN-Bedroom 与 CelebA-HQ 数据集上，针对高斯去模糊与超分辨率任务做实验。如图 5 所示，我们观察到与随机编码相比，随机重采样能重建出更平滑、PSNR 更高的图像，印证了我们的理论。

English original
Effectiveness of the Resampling Technique. Here, we validate our theoretical results by conducting ablation studies on stochastic resampling. Specifically, we perform experiments on the LSUN-Bedroom and CelebA-HQ datasets with tasks of Gaussian deblurring and super-resolution. As shown in Figure 5, we observe that stochastic resampling reconstructs smoother images with higher PSNRs compared to stochastic encoding, corroborating our theory.

硬数据一致性的有效性。在图 6 中，我们针对 CT 重建对 ReSample 的执行频率做了消融研究。这一观察与我们的直觉预期一致：更多的 ReSample 时间步（即更多的数据一致性）带来更准确的重建。更具体地说，我们在图 6（右）中观察到，如果执行更多次 ReSample，我们得到 PSNR 更高的重建。

English original
Effectiveness of Hard Data Consistency. In Figure 6, we perform an ablation study on the ReSample frequency on CT reconstruction. This observation is in line with what we expect intuitively, as more ReSample time steps (i.e., more data consistency) lead to more accurate reconstructions. More specifically, we observe in Figure 6 (right) that if we perform more iterations of ReSample, we obtain reconstructions with higher PSNR.

内存效率。为展示算法的内存效率，我们使用 nvidia-smi 命令监控求解逆问题期间的内存消耗，并与基线比较。我们在表 4 中给出 FFHQ 数据集上高斯去模糊的内存占用。虽然整个 LDM 模型由于自编码器而占用更多内存，但我们的算法本身表现出内存效率，从而带来更低的整体内存占用。这凸显了它在医学成像等领域中的潜力，因为在这些领域内存复杂度直接关系到可行性。

English original
Memory Efficiency. To demonstrate the memory efficiency of our algorithm, we use the command nvidia-smi to monitor the memory consumption during solving an inverse problem, in comparison to our baselines. We present the memory usage for Gaussian deblurring on the FFHQ dataset in Table 4. Although the entire LDM models occupy more memory due to the autoencoders, our algorithm itself exhibits memory efficiency, resulting in lower overall memory usage. This underscores its potential in domains like medical imaging, where memory complexity plays a crucial role in feasibility.

5 结论

English original
5 Conclusion

本文提出 ReSample，一种能有效利用 LDM 求解一般逆问题的算法。我们证明了：(1) 与许多基线相比，我们的算法能重建高质量图像；(2) 我们可以微调现有模型用于医学成像任务，并进一步降低内存占用。我们方法的一个根本局限在于硬数据一致性的计算开销，我们把它留作未来工作需要应对和改进的重要挑战。

English original
In this paper, we propose ReSample, an algorithm that can effectively leverage LDMs to solve general inverse problems. We demonstrated that (1) our algorithm can reconstruct high-quality images compared to many baselines and (2) we can fine-tune existing models for medical imaging tasks and achieve an additional reduction in memory usage. One fundamental limitation of our method lies in the computational overhead of hard data consistency, which we leave as a significant challenge for future work to address and improve upon.

To illustrate the validity of this approach, we conducted a random-inpainting experiment with images of dimensions (512×512×3)(512\times512\times3)(512×512×3) and report the results in Figure 8. 跳步步长的影响。本节我们做消融研究，考察算法中跳步步长的影响。跳步步长指在施加下一次硬数据一致性之前“跳过”的频率。例如，跳步步长为 101010 意味着每 101010 次反向采样迭代执行一次硬数据一致性。直觉上，人们可能期望更少的跳步（即更频繁的硬数据一致性）带来更好的重建。为验证这一直觉，我们做了跳步步长对 CT 重建影响的实验，结果展示在图 19，对应的推理时间见表 16。我们观察到，当跳步步长在 111 到 101010 之间时，结果非常相似。不过考虑到如表 16 所示跳步步长为 101010 时所需时间显著减少，我们在实验设定中选择跳步步长 101010，以在重建质量与推理时间之间取得平衡。最后我们要指出，在图 19 中，跳步步长 444 相比跳步 111 表现出（非常）轻微的提升。由于反向采样过程以随机噪声向量开始，结果存在少量波动，跳步步长 111 与 444 的平均结果非常接近。

English original
Effect of the Skip Step Size. In this section, we conduct an ablation study to investigate the impact of the skip step size in our algorithm. The skip step size denotes the frequency at which we ‘skip’ before applying the next hard data consistency. For instance, a skip step size of 101010 implies that we apply hard data consistency every 101010 iterations of the reverse sampling process. Intuitively, one might expect that fewer skip steps would lead to better reconstructions, indicating more frequent hard data consistency steps. To validate this intuition, we conducted an experiment on the effect of the skip step size on CT reconstruction, and the results are displayed in Figure 19, with corresponding inference times in Table 16. We observe that for skip step sizes ranging from 111 to 101010, the results are very similar. However, considering the significantly reduced time required for a skip step size of 101010 as shown in Table 16, we chose a skip step size of 101010 in our experimental setting in order to balance the trade-off between reconstruction quality and inference time. Lastly, we would like to note that in Figure 19, a skip step size of 444 exhibits a (very) slight improvement over a skip step of 111. Due to the reverse sampling process initiating with a random noise vector, there is a minor variability in the results, with the average outcomes for skip step sizes of 111 and 444 being very similar.

计算效率。这里我们在表 10 与表 12 中给出 ReSample 与基线相比的内存占用和推理时间。我们观察到，当预训练扩散模型规模增大时，ReSample 与其他算法之间的内存差距会拉大，因为 ReSample 的硬数据一致性步骤所需内存极小。反过来，由于我们只在全部采样步的一个子集中施加硬数据一致性（这与在每个时间步都做一致性更新的现有方法不同），我们注意到推理时间相比 DPS、DMPS 和 MCG 等算法略有增加。在推理时间上，ReSample 优于 PSLD。

English original
Computational Efficiency. Here, we present the memory usage and inference times of ReSample compared to our baselines in Tables 10 and 12. We observe that the memory gap between ReSample and other algorithms widens when the pre-trained diffusion model increases in size, as the hard data consistency step of ReSample requires minimal memory. Conversely, since we only apply hard data consistency in a subset of all sampling steps (which differs from existing methods that perform consistency updates at every time step), we note a slight increase in inference time compared to algorithms such as DPS, DMPS, and MCG. ReSample outperforms PSLD in terms of inference time.

关于 Latent-DPS 的讨论。在正文中，我们简要讨论了把 Latent-DPS 梯度项加入 ReSample 算法可能提升整体重建质量。总体而言，我们观察到加入 Latent-DPS 梯度只会带来非常边际的 PSNR 提升，而且只有在学习率尺度选择“正确”时才会如此。有趣的是，我们观察到 αˉt\bar{\alpha}_tαˉt​ 的选择对 Latent-DPS 的性能至关重要。为此，我们对 Latent-DPS 的学习率做了简要消融研究：把学习率取为 kαˉtk\bar{\alpha}_tkαˉt​（某个 k>0k>0k>0）。我们变化 kkk，在 50 张胸部 CT 图像上测试性能，结果见表 13。在表 13 中我们观察到 k=0.5k=0.5k=0.5 给出最佳结果；若有人采用把 Latent-DPS 加入 ReSample 的做法，应选择该值。

English original
Discussion on Latent-DPS. In the main text, we briefly discussed how adding the Latent-DPS gradient term into our ReSample algorithm can improve the overall reconstruction quality. Generally, we observe that adding the Latent-DPS gradient will cause a very marginal boost in the PSNR, but only when the learning rate scale is chosen “correctly”. Interestingly, we observe that choosing αˉt\bar{\alpha}_tαˉt​ is critical in the performance of Latent-DPS. To this end, we perform a brief ablation study on the learning rate for Latent-DPS, where we choose the learning rate to be kαˉtk\bar{\alpha}_tkαˉt​ for some k>0k>0k>0. We vary kkk and test the performance on 50 images of chest CT images and display the results in Table 13. In Table 13, we observe that k=0.5k=0.5k=0.5 returns the best results, and should be chosen if one were to adopt the method of adding Latent-DPS into ReSample.

LDM 的训练效率。为突出本工作的意义，我们做了一项关注 LDM 训练效率的消融研究。该研究表明 LDM 训练所需的计算资源显著更少，这一特性对医学成像等下游应用尤其有利。为支持这一论断，我们给出 LDM 在医学图像合成场景下的训练时间与性能，并与 DDPM [23] 比较。对于 LDM，我们使用 [19] 提供的预训练自编码器与 LDM 架构，在来自 LDCT 训练集 [41] 的 40 位患者、三个器官的 9000 张 2D CT 切片上训练。对于 DDPM，我们使用 [23] 提供的代码库，在同一批 2D CT 训练切片上训练基于像素的扩散模型。结果与验证集 10 位患者的 300 张 2D 切片比较，详见表 14。观察表 14 的结果，我们注意到使用 LDM 可以显著减少训练时间与内存占用，同时以 FID 分数衡量的生成质量更好。

English original
Training Efficiency of LDMs. To underscore the significance of our work, we conducted an ablation study focusing on the training efficiency of LDMs. This study demonstrates that LDMs require significantly fewer computational resources for training, a trait particularly beneficial for downstream applications like medical imaging. To support this assertion, we present the training time and performance of LDMs, comparing them to DDPMs [23] in the context of medical image synthesis. For LDMs, we utilized the pretrained autoencoder and LDM architecture provided by [19], training them on 9000 2D CT slices from three organs across 40 patients sourced from the LDCT training set [41]. In the case of DDPMs, we employed the codebase provided by [23] to train pixel-based diffusion models on the same set of 2D CT training slices. The results are presented in comparison with 300 2D slices from 10 patients in the validation set, detailed in Table 14. Observing the results in Table 14, we note that by utilizing LDMs, we can significantly reduce training time and memory usage while achieving better generation quality, as measured by the FID score.

Appendix B Discussion on Hard Data Consistency

回顾硬数据一致性步骤涉及求解如下优化问题：

English original
Recall that the hard data consistency step involves solving the following optimization problem:
公式 (14)
z^0(y)∈arg min⁡z 12∥y−A(D(z))∥22,\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{y}) \in \underset{\boldsymbol{z}}{\operatorname*{arg\,min}}\,\frac{1}{2}\|\boldsymbol{y}-\mathcal{A}(\mathcal{D}(\boldsymbol{z}))\|_2^2,z^0​(y)∈zargmin​21​∥y−A(D(z))∥22​,

其中我们用 z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​) 初始化。注意到，我们也可以不直接求解潜变量 z\boldsymbol{z}z，而是改为求解朴素的（逐像素）最小二乘：

where we initialize using z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​). Instead of solving for the latent variable z\boldsymbol{z}z directly, notice that one possible technique would be to instead solve for vanilla least squares:

English original
where we instead initialize using D(z^0(zt))\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t))D(z^0​(zt​)), where D(⋅)\mathcal{D}(\cdot)D(⋅) denotes the decoder. Similarly, our goal here is to find the x^0(y)\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_0(\boldsymbol{y})x^0​(y) that is close to D(z^0(zt))\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t))D(z^0​(zt​)) that satisfies the measurement consistency: ∥y−A(x)∥22<σ2\|\boldsymbol{y}-\mathcal{A}(\boldsymbol{x})\|_2^2 < \sigma^2∥y−A(x)∥22​<σ2, where σ2\sigma^2σ2 is an estimated noise level. Throughout the rest of the Appendix, we refer to the former optimization process as latent optimization and the latter as pixel optimization.

在我们的实验中，我们实际上发现这两种不同表述会给出不同结果：潜优化给出“含噪”但更锐利、细节更好的重建，而像素优化给出“更平滑”但模糊、保留高层语义信息的结果。直观上，像素优化不直接改变潜变量，而潜优化直接在潜变量上优化。此外，编码器 E(⋅)\mathcal{E}(\cdot)E(⋅) 可能给估计的 z^0(y)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{y})z^0​(y) 增加额外误差，可能把样本挤出数据流形，从而产生模糊的图像。

English original
In our experiments, we actually found that these two different formulations yield different results, in the sense that performing latent optimization gives reconstructions that are “noisy”, yet much sharper with fine details, whereas pixel optimization gives results that are “smoother” yet blurry with high-level semantic information. Here, the intuition is that pixel optimization does not directly change the latent variable where as latent optimization directly optimizes over the latent variable. Moreover, the encoder E(⋅)\mathcal{E}(\cdot)E(⋅) can add additional errors to the estimated z^0(y)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{y})z^0​(y), perhaps throwing the sample off the data manifold, yielding images that are blurry as a result.

这两种方法在时间复杂度上也有显著差异。由于潜优化在每一步梯度上都需要通过解码器 D(⋅)\mathcal{D}(\cdot)D(⋅) 的整个网络反向传播，得到局部极小值（或收敛）所需时间长得多。在实践中，为平衡重建速度与图像质量之间的权衡，我们看到同时使用这两种表述来做硬数据一致性不仅能取得最好的结果，还能加速优化过程。由于像素优化容易得到全局最优解，我们在反向采样过程中先使用它，然后在更接近 t=0t=0t=0 时使用潜优化，以更精细的细节改进图像。

English original
There is also a significant difference in time complexity between these two methods. Since latent optimization needs to backpropagate through the whole network of the decoder D(⋅)\mathcal{D}(\cdot)D(⋅) on every gradient step, it takes much longer to obtain a local minimum (or converge). Empirically, to balance the trade-off between reconstruction speed and image quality, we see that using both of these formulations for hard data consistency can not only yield the best results, but also speed up the optimization process. Since pixel optimization is easy to get a global optimum, we use it first during the reverse sampling process and then use latent optimization when we are closer to t=0t=0t=0 to refine the images with the finer details.

最后我们要指出，对于像素优化，在特定设定下可以利用一个闭式解 [28]。若前向算子 A\mathcal{A}A 是线性的、可以写成矩阵形式 A\mathbf{A}A，且测量无噪声（即 y=A(x^0(y))\boldsymbol{y}=\mathcal{A}(\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_0(\boldsymbol{y}))y=A(x^0​(y))），则我们可以把优化问题写成

English original
Lastly, we would like to remark that for pixel optimization, there is a closed-form solution that could be leveraged under specific settings [28]. If the forward operator A\mathcal{A}A is linear and can take the matrix form A\mathbf{A}A and the measurements are noiseless (i.e., y=A(x^0(y))\boldsymbol{y} = \mathcal{A}(\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_0(\boldsymbol{y}))y=A(x^0​(y))), then we can pose the optimization problem as
公式 (16)
x^0(y)∈arg min⁡x 12∥D(z^0(zt))−x∥22,s.t.Ax=y.\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_0(\boldsymbol{y}) \in \underset{\boldsymbol{x}}{\operatorname*{arg\,min}}\,\frac{1}{2}\|\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t))-\boldsymbol{x}\|_2^2,\quad \text{s.t.}\quad \mathbf{A}\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{y}.x^0​(y)∈xargmin​21​∥D(z^0​(zt​))−x∥22​,s.t.Ax=y.

那么该优化问题的解为

English original
Then, the solution to this optimization problem is given by
公式 (17)
x^0(y)=D(z^0(zt))−(A+AD(z^0(zt))−A+y),\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_0(\boldsymbol{y}) = \mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)) - \left(\mathbf{A}^{+}\mathbf{A}\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)) - \mathbf{A}^{+}\boldsymbol{y}\right),x^0​(y)=D(z^0​(zt​))−(A+AD(z^0​(zt​))−A+y),

其中借助编码器，我们得到

English original
where by employing the encoder, we obtain
公式 (18)
z^0(y)=E(x^0(y))=E ⁣(D(z^0(zt))−(A+AD(z^0(zt))−A+y)).\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{y}) = \mathcal{E}(\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_0(\boldsymbol{y})) = \mathcal{E}\!\left(\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)) - \left(\mathbf{A}^{+}\mathbf{A}\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)) - \mathbf{A}^{+}\boldsymbol{y}\right)\right).z^0​(y)=E(x^0​(y))=E(D(z^0​(zt​))−(A+AD(z^0​(zt​))−A+y)).

这种优化技术不需要迭代求解器，计算效率很高。在下一节中，我们给出在测量可能含噪时计算闭式解的方法。

English original
This optimization technique does not require iterative solvers and offers great computational efficiency. In the following section, we provide ways in which we can compute a closed-form solution in the case in which the measurements may be noisy.

B.1 用共轭梯度加速像素优化

English original
B.1 Accelerated Pixel Optimization by Conjugate Gradient

注意到由于像素优化直接在像素空间操作，对于线性逆问题我们可以使用共轭梯度最小二乘等求解器。令 A\mathbf{A}A 是线性算子 A(⋅)\mathcal{A}(\cdot)A(⋅) 的矩阵形式。那么，如上一小节所述，无噪声设定下优化问题的解为

English original
Notice that since pixel optimization directly operates in the pixel space, we can use solvers such as conjugate gradients least squares for linear inverse problems. Let A\mathbf{A}A be the matrix form of the linear operator A(⋅)\mathcal{A}(\cdot)A(⋅). Then, as discussed in the previous subsection, the solution to the optimization problem in the noiseless setting is given by
公式 (19)
x^=x0−(A+Ax0−A+y),\hat{\boldsymbol{x}} = \boldsymbol{x}_0 - \left(\mathbf{A}^{+}\mathbf{A}\boldsymbol{x}_0 - \mathbf{A}^{+}\boldsymbol{y}\right),x^=x0​−(A+Ax0​−A+y),

其中 A+=A⊤(AA⊤)−1\mathbf{A}^{+}=\mathbf{A}^{\top}(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{A}^{\top})^{-1}A+=A⊤(AA⊤)−1，而 (AA⊤)−1(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{A}^{\top})^{-1}(AA⊤)−1 可以由共轭梯度实现。在存在测量噪声时，我们可以把该解放松为

English original
where A+=A⊤(AA⊤)−1\mathbf{A}^{+} = \mathbf{A}^{\top}(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{A}^{\top})^{-1}A+=A⊤(AA⊤)−1 and (AA⊤)−1(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{A}^{\top})^{-1}(AA⊤)−1 can be implemented by conjugate gradients. In the presence of measurement noise, we can relax this solution to
公式 (20)
x^=x0−κ(A+Ax0−A+y),\hat{\boldsymbol{x}} = \boldsymbol{x}_0 - \kappa\left(\mathbf{A}^{+}\mathbf{A}\boldsymbol{x}_0 - \mathbf{A}^{+}\boldsymbol{y}\right),x^=x0​−κ(A+Ax0​−A+y),

κ∈(0,1)\kappa\in(0,1)κ∈(0,1) 是超参数，可以削弱测量的噪声成分与 x0\boldsymbol{x}_0x0​（优化前的初始图像，我们使用 D(z^0(zt))\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t))D(z^0​(zt​))）之间的影响。我们在 CT 重建中使用这一技术，其中前向算子 A\mathbf{A}A 是 Radon 变换，A⊤\mathbf{A}^{\top}A⊤ 是非滤波反投影。不过，只要矩阵 A\mathbf{A}A 可得，我们就可以把这一共轭梯度技术用于任何线性逆问题。

English original
κ∈(0,1)\kappa \in (0,1)κ∈(0,1) is a hyperparameter that can reduce the impact between the noisy component of the measurements and x0\boldsymbol{x}_0x0​ (the initial image before optimization, for which we use D(z^0(zt))\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t))D(z^0​(zt​))). We use this technique for CT reconstruction, where the forward operator A\mathbf{A}A is the radon transform and A⊤\mathbf{A}^{\top}A⊤ is the non-filtered back projection. However, we can use this conjugate gradient technique for any linear inverse problem where the matrix A\mathbf{A}A is available.

附录 D 关于 Latent-DPS 失败情形的更多讨论

English original
Appendix D More Discussion on the Failure Cases of Latent-DPS

本节我们进一步解释 Latent-DPS 为何经常无法给出准确的重建。

English original
In this section, we provide a further explanation to which why Latent-DPS often fails to give accurate reconstructions.

D.1 测量一致性的失效

English original
D.1 Failure of Measurement Consistency

此前我们声称，使用 Latent-DPS 很可能收敛到函数 ∥y−A(D(z^0))∥22\|\mathbf{y}-\mathcal{A}(\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0))\|_2^2∥y−A(D(z^0​))∥22​ 的局部极小值，因而无法取得准确的测量一致性。这里我们通过比较 Latent-DPS 与 ReSample 之间的测量一致性损失来验证这一主张。我们观察到 ReSample 能取得比 Latent-DPS 更好的测量一致性。这一观察验证了我们用硬数据一致性提升重建质量的动机。

English original
Previously, we claimed that by using Latent-DPS, it is likely that we converge to a local minimum of the function ∥y−A(D(z^0))∥22\|\mathbf{y}-\mathcal{A}(\mathcal{D}(\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0))\|_2^2∥y−A(D(z^0​))∥22​ and hence cannot achieve accurate measurement consistency. Here, we validate this claim by comparing the measurement consistency loss between Latent-DPS and ReSample. We observe that ReSample is able to achieve better measurement consistency than Latent-DPS. This observation validates our motivation of using hard data consistency to improve reconstruction quality.

D.2 线性流形假设的失效

English original
D.2 Failure of Linear Manifold Assumption

我们猜测 Latent-DPS 无法给出准确重建的一个原因，可能在于解码器 D(⋅)\mathcal{D}(\cdot)D(⋅) 的非线性。更具体地说，[11] 给出的 DPS 推导依赖于一个线性流形假设。在我们的情形中，由于前向模型可以看作 A(D(⋅))\mathcal{A}(\mathcal{D}(\cdot))A(D(⋅)) 的形式，其中解码器 D(⋅)\mathcal{D}(\cdot)D(⋅) 是高度非线性的神经网络，这一线性流形假设不再成立。例如，若两张图像 z(1)\boldsymbol{z}^{(1)}z(1) 与 z(2)\boldsymbol{z}^{(2)}z(2) 位于 t=0t=0t=0 的干净数据分布流形 M\mathcal{M}M 上，它们的某个线性组合 az(1)+bz(2)a\boldsymbol{z}^{(1)}+b\boldsymbol{z}^{(2)}az(1)+bz(2)（a,ba,ba,b 为常数）可能不属于 M\mathcal{M}M，因为 D(az(1)+bz(2))\mathcal{D}(a\boldsymbol{z}^{(1)}+b\boldsymbol{z}^{(2)})D(az(1)+bz(2)) 可能给不出真实的图像。因此，在实践中我们观察到 DPS 的重建倾向于更模糊，这意味着反向采样路径偏离了该数据流形。我们在图 20 中展示这一点：两个潜向量的平均会给出模糊且不真实的图像。

English original
We hypothesize that one reason that Latent-DPS fails to give accurate reconstructions could due to the nonlinearity of the decoder D(⋅)\mathcal{D}(\cdot)D(⋅). More specifically, the derivation of DPS provided by [11] relies on a linear manifold assumption. For our case, since our forward model can be viewed as the form A(D(⋅))\mathcal{A}(\mathcal{D}(\cdot))A(D(⋅)), where the decoder D(⋅)\mathcal{D}(\cdot)D(⋅) is a highly nonlinear neural network, this linear manifold assumption fails to hold. For example, if two images z(1)\boldsymbol{z}^{(1)}z(1) and z(2)\boldsymbol{z}^{(2)}z(2) lie on the clean data distribution manifold M\mathcal{M}M at t=0t = 0t=0, a linear combination of them az(1)+bz(2)a\boldsymbol{z}^{(1)}+ b\boldsymbol{z}^{(2)}az(1)+bz(2) for some constants aaa and bbb, may not belong to M\mathcal{M}M since D(az(1)+bz(2))\mathcal{D}(a\boldsymbol{z}^{(1)}+ b\boldsymbol{z}^{(2)})D(az(1)+bz(2)) may not give us an image that is realistic. Thus, in practice, we observe that DPS reconstructions tend to be more blurry, which implies that the reverse sampling path falls out of this data manifold. We demonstrate this in Figure 20, where we show that the average of two latent vectors gives a blurry and unrealistic image.

我们要指出，这一推理或许也能解释为什么我们的算法在非线性逆任务上优于 DPS。

English original
We would like to point out that this reasoning may also explain why our algorithm outperforms DPS on nonlinear inverse tasks.

D.3 后验均值估计不准确

English original
D.3 Inaccurate Estimates of the Posterior Mean

本节我们讨论 z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​)（即通过 Tweedie 公式得到的后验均值）估计不准确，为何可能是 Latent-DPS 返回含噪图像重建的原因之一。这主要是因为当 ttt 更接近 t=Tt=Tt=T 时，z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​) 的估计可能不准确，导致我们在 t=0t=0t=0 得到含噪图像。总体而言，我们发现 z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​) 的估计在较早的时间步（例如 t>0.5Tt>0.5Tt>0.5T）不准确，并且随 ttt 减小而大幅变化。这意味着当 ttt 较大时，梯度更新可能指向不一致的方向。我们在图 21 中进一步展示这一观察。

English original
In this section, we discuss how inaccurate estimates of z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​) (i.e., the posterior mean via Tweedie's formula) can be one of the reasons why Latent-DPS returns image reconstructions that are noisy. This was mainly because for values of ttt closer to t=Tt=Tt=T, the estimate of z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​) may be inaccurate, leading us to images that are noisy at t=0t=0t=0. Generally, we find that the estimation of z^0(zt)\hat{\boldsymbol{z}}_0(\boldsymbol{z}_t)z^0​(zt​) is inaccurate in the early timesteps (e.g. t>0.5Tt > 0.5Tt>0.5T) and vary a lot when ttt decreases. This implies that the gradient update may not point to a consistent direction when ttt is large. We further demonstrate this observation in Figure 21.

附录 E 相关工作

English original
Appendix E Related Works

深度神经网络已被广泛用作求解逆问题的先验 [39], [40], [46], [47]。大量工作专注于学习测量与干净图像之间的映射，我们称之为有监督方法 [46], [47], [48], [49]。有监督方法需要在测量与干净图像的成对数据上训练，每遇到一个新任务都需要重新训练模型。另一方面，另一条研究路线旨在学习真值图像的先验分布，在推理时利用预训练的先验分布求解逆问题而无需重训 [29], [30], [32], [50]。我们把这一类归为无监督方法。

English original
Deep neural networks have been extensively employed as priors for solving inverse problems [39], [40], [46], [47]. Numerous works focus on learning the mapping between measurements and clean images, which we term as supervised methods [46], [47], [48], [49]. Supervised methods necessitate training on pairs of measurements and clean images, requiring model retraining for each new task. On the other hand, another line of research aims at learning the prior distribution of ground truth images, solving inverse problems at inference time without retraining by using the pre-trained prior distributions [29], [30], [32], [50]. We categorize this as unsupervised methods.

在扩散模型出现之前，无监督方法相比有监督方法往往难以取得令人满意的重建质量 [30]。这些方法依赖在受限空间内做优化 [29]，而构造一个能准确编码真值数据分布的空间来求解该优化问题是有挑战的。然而，随着扩散模型现在能提供对先验分布的准确近似，无监督方法在求解逆问题时可以比有监督方法更高效地取得更好结果，而无需重新训练模型 [24], [30]。

English original
Until the advent of diffusion models, unsupervised methods struggled to achieve satisfactory reconstruction quality compared to supervised methods [30]. These methods rely on optimization within a constrained space [29], while constructing a space that accurately encodes the ground truth data distribution to solve the optimization problem is challenging. However, with the accurate approximation of the prior distribution now provided by diffusion models, unsupervised methods can outperform supervised methods for solving inverse problems more efficiently without retraining the model [24], [30].

对于使用扩散模型作为先验的无监督方法，即插即用（plug-and-play）做法已被广泛应用于求解线性逆问题 [13], [24], [28]。这些方法把测量注入到含噪流形上，或把真值图像的估计纳入反向采样过程。我们把这类方法称为硬数据一致性方法，因为它们把测量直接注入反向采样过程。然而据我们所知，这些方法中只有少数扩展到非线性逆问题、甚至扩展到潜扩散模型 [19]。其他方法专注于在温和假设下用梯度方法近似条件分数 [7], [11], [12]。虽然这些方法能取得出色性能并可扩展到非线性逆问题，但如本文所示，测量一致性可能被牺牲。由于这些方法只通过反向采样过程中的梯度来施加数据一致性，我们把它们称为软数据一致性方法。

English original
For unsupervised approaches using diffusion models as priors, the plug-and-play approach has been widely applied for solving linear inverse problems [13], [24], [28]. These methods inject the measurement on the noisy manifold or incorporate an estimate of the ground truth image into the reverse sampling procedure. We refer to these methods as hard data consistency approaches, as they directly inject the measurements into the reverse sampling process. However, to the best of our knowledge, only a few of these methods extend to nonlinear inverse problems or even latent diffusion models [19]. Other approaches focus on approximating the conditional score [7], [11], [12] under some mild assumptions using gradient methods. While these methods can achieve excellent performance and be extended to nonlinear inverse problems, measurement consistency may be compromised, as demonstrated in our paper. Since these methods apply data consistency only through a gradient in the reverse sampling process, we refer to these methods as soft data consistency approaches.

近来，在潜空间或受限域中用扩散模型对数据分布建模的兴趣日益增长 [51], [52], [53]。用潜扩散模型求解逆问题也日益受到关注。特别地，[22] 提出了 PSLD，一种无监督的软方法，它在每个反向采样步加入梯度项，用 LDM 求解线性逆问题。然而，也有工作观察到这种做法可能由于梯度项估计而出现不稳定 [54]。我们的工作提出一种无监督的硬方法，通过“重采样”并施加硬数据一致性，用潜扩散模型求解一般逆问题（线性和非线性）。采用硬数据一致性的做法使我们能获得好得多的重建，凸显了我们算法的有效性。

English original
Recently, there has been a growing interest in modeling the data distribution by diffusion models in a latent space or a constraint domain [51], [52], [53]. There has also been a growing interest in solving inverse problems using latent diffusion models. In particular, [22] proposed PSLD, an unsupervised soft approach that adds a gradient term at each reverse sampling step to solve linear inverse problems with LDMs. However, there are works that observe that this approach may suffer from instability due to estimating the gradient term [54]. Our work proposes an unsupervised hard approach that involves “resampling” and enforcing hard data consistency for solving general inverse problems (both linear and nonlinear) using latent diffusion models. By using a hard data consistency approach, we can obtain much better reconstructions, highlighting the effectiveness of our algorithm.

∇2λ(zˉt)=Cov(z0∣zt)=(1−αˉt)2αˉt∇2log⁡p(zt)+1−αˉtαˉtI.\nabla^2\lambda(\bar{\boldsymbol{z}}_t) = \text{Cov}(\boldsymbol{z}_0\mid\boldsymbol{z}_t) = \frac{(1-\bar{\alpha}_t)^2}{\bar{\alpha}_t}\nabla^2\log p(\boldsymbol{z}_t) + \frac{1-\bar{\alpha}_t}{\bar{\alpha}_t}\boldsymbol{I}.∇2λ(zˉt​)=Cov(z0​∣zt​)=αˉt​(1−αˉt​)2​∇2logp(zt​)+αˉt​1−αˉt​​I.

这就给出了所需结果。

English original
This gives the desired result.
